newsitem.title: USA: Diablo Canyon nuclear unit at 50 pct to mid-Monday.
newsitem.headline: Diablo Canyon nuclear unit at 50 pct to mid-Monday.

text.p: The 1,073 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Diablo Canyon nuclear power plant will hold at 50 percent power until midday Monday before continuing to ramp up, Pacific Gas & Electric Co, the plant's operator, said early Monday.
The unit, located at Avila Beach on California's central coast, was manually shut early Wednesday due to a problem with its feedwater system.
The company was unable to determine the exact cause of the feedwater problem, but said all components were checked and tested, clearing the way for restart over the weekend.
Diablo Canyon's 1,087 MW unit 1 was said to be operating normally.
